scopeNote: Day-trip and short-stay food around Phuket: Phang Nga (Khok Kloi, Phang Nga town, Koh Panyee, Lam Kaen near Thap Lamu pier, Khao Lak, Takua Pa), Krabi (Krabi Town, Ao Nang, Ao Nam Mao, Nopparat Thara, Railay, Klong Muang), Koh Phi Phi Don (Tonsai), Koh Yao Noi and Koh Yao Yai, and Koh Lanta (Saladan, Long Beach, Kantiang), with lunch stops near piers and roads first and a few dinners for a night there.

items.name: Thian Leng Bak Kut Teh
items.nameThai: เทียนเหล็ง บะกุ๊ดเต๋
items.gmapsQuery: Thian Leng Bak Kut Teh, 35 Mu 4, Phet Kasem Road, Khok Kloi, Takua Thung, Phang Nga
items.priceText: No dish prices found online. Michelin puts it in its lowest price band (one baht sign).
dishes: Bak kut teh: pork rib soup with Chinese herbs, Kedah (Malaysia) style, served in a clay pot
items.praise: Michelin inspectors write that the ribs are slow-cooked until the meat comes off the bone, and that the shop is so sure of the soup that it offers your money back if you do not like it (Michelin Guide, 2026 selection).
items.watchOut: Breakfast and lunch only: it closes at 16:00 (Sunday 15:00). Cash only.
items.description: A roadside shop on the highway at Khok Kloi, about 25 minutes north of Phuket Airport, that cooks one thing: Malaysian-style pork rib soup. The easiest pork stop on any drive north to Khao Lak or Phang Nga.
items.bestTime: Breakfast or early lunch on the way north.
tips: Order rice and Chinese tea with the soup.
Baan Rearn Mai seafood is 500 m away if the group wants a second, bigger meal.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.4, open hours shown, pin on Phet Kasem Road at Khok Kloi). Michelin page read 27 Oct 2026 (Selected, hours, cash only). No review count found.

items.name: Baan Rearn Mai Seafood
items.nameThai: ร้านอาหารบ้านเรือนไม้ ซีฟู้ด
items.gmapsQuery: Baan Rearn Mai, 37/18 Mu 4, Khok Kloi, Takua Thung, Phang Nga
items.priceText: No dish prices found online. Michelin rates it two baht signs (mid-price). Crab is priced by size.
dishes: Yellow curry with crab (the house signature)
Steamed sea bass with soy sauce
items.praise: Michelin (2026 selection) notes 25 years of light, fresh seafood cooking and singles out the steamed sea bass with soy sauce. Google rating 4.7 in Oct 2026.
items.watchOut: Open only until 18:00, so it is a lunch place. Cash only.
items.description: A small wooden seafood house in Khok Kloi, 25 minutes north of Phuket Airport, known for its yellow crab curry. A good lunch on the drive to Khao Lak or back from Phang Nga Bay.
tips: Ask the price of crab before they cook it.
Thian Leng pork rib soup is next door for breakfast.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.7, open, pin in Khok Kloi). Michelin page read 27 Oct 2026. No review count found.

items.name: Aulis Phuket
items.nameThai: อาวลิส ภูเก็ต
items.gmapsQuery: Aulis Phuket, Iniala Beach House, 40/14 Mu 6, Ban Natai, Khok Kloi, Phang Nga
items.michelin: One Michelin star, Thailand 2026 guide (the only starred restaurant in Phang Nga)
items.priceText: Tasting menu price is not published on its website or the Michelin page; Michelin rates it four baht signs (the top band). A credit card is needed to hold the booking.
dishes: Multi-course tasting menu from Thai and local farm produce, served at a chef's counter
Non-alcoholic drinks pairing (Michelin says it is worth trying)
items.praise: Simon Rogan's first restaurant in Thailand, opened December 2023, holds one Michelin star. Michelin inspectors describe a tasting menu built on native ingredients from local growers, served at an open kitchen counter.
items.watchOut: Only 15 seats at one counter: 8 people would fill half of it. Closed for the low season until about 16 Nov 2026 (website). Groups of 5 or more must change or cancel at least 10 days ahead.
items.description: A 15-seat chef's table inside Iniala Beach House on Natai Beach, about 25 minutes north of Phuket Airport. The one Michelin-starred special dinner in the region.
items.openText: Tue-Sat, one dinner sitting from 18:30; lunch on request (website, Oct 2026)
items.bestTime: Book weeks ahead for a Tuesday to Saturday dinner.
tips: Book online, by phone +66 96 604 5469 or by email info@aulisphuket.com.
Allow 1 hour each way by car from Patong.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (5.0, fine dining, opens 18:30, pin at Iniala Beach House). Michelin page read 27 Oct 2026 (star, closed for the season at the time). Website read 27 Oct 2026 (closed 16 May to 16 Nov, 15 seats, Tue-Sat 18:30). No review count found.

items.name: Khun Thip's Satay
items.nameThai: หมูสะเต๊ะเมืองพังงา คุณทิพย์
items.gmapsQuery: Khun Thip's Satay, 184 Phet Kasem Road, Thai Chang, Mueang Phang Nga
items.priceText: Set menus only, minimum 10 skewers (Michelin, 2026). No current skewer price found; Michelin rates it one baht sign.
dishes: Pork satay with peanut sauce and cucumber relish
items.praise: Grilling satay since 1975. Michelin (2026 selection) recommends the pork satay for its tender meat, coconut aroma and sweet peanut sauce, and also the liver and intestine skewers.
items.watchOut: Lunch only, 11:00-15:00, and closed on Tuesday and Wednesday. Cash only.
items.description: A satay shop in Phang Nga town that has done pork satay sets for 50 years. Phang Nga town is the land side of the Phang Nga Bay (James Bond Island) trips, so it fits a lunch before or after the boat.
items.bestTime: Lunch, before it sells out in the afternoon.
tips: A group of 8 can share the meat set and a seafood set.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.4, opens Thursday 11:00, closed Tue). Michelin page read 27 Oct 2026. No review count found.

items.name: Koh Panyee floating village restaurants
items.nameThai: เกาะปันหยี
items.gmapsQuery: Ko Panyi floating village, Phang Nga
items.ratingSource: Google Maps, 27 Oct 2026: the village itself 4.4; sample restaurants Mariya Sea View 4.1, Panyi Restaurant 3.9
items.priceText: Most visitors eat a set lunch that is part of the tour price. No current a la carte prices found.
items.praise: Phuket101 (updated Mar 2026): the food is decent rather than special, but the seafood is fresh because it is still a working fishing village; the writer has had good tom yum goong there more than once.
items.watchOut: This is a tour-group lunch stop: about a dozen big restaurants on stilts fill up between 11:00 and 13:00. It is a Muslim village: no pork and no alcohol anywhere, and you should not bring any.
items.description: The fishing village on stilts in Phang Nga Bay where most James Bond Island tours stop for lunch. Go for the setting and fresh seafood, not for a great meal.
items.bestTime: Lunch, early (before 11:00) if you come by private longtail.
tips: Grilled squid and satay from the small stalls are cheaper than the big restaurants (Phuket101, 2026).
Panyee Muteara Seafood is the best known of the restaurants.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026: village pin 4.4; Mariya Sea View restaurant (4.1, 10:00-16:00) and Panyi Restaurant (3.9) checked; Panyee Muteara did not come up by name. Phuket101 page updated 26 Mar 2026.

items.name: Mun Pochana
items.nameThai: มันโภชนา
items.gmapsQuery: Mun Pochana, 46/11 Phet Kasem Road, Lam Kaen, Thai Mueang, Phang Nga
items.michelin: Michelin Bib Gourmand, Thailand 2026 guide (listed as "Mun")
items.priceText: No dish prices found online. Michelin rates it one baht sign (cheap).
dishes: Pork ribs in fermented black bean sauce
Daily catch cooked Southern Thai style
items.praise: Michelin (2026 Bib Gourmand): a long-standing local favourite, recently renovated, with bold Southern Thai flavours in generous portions; inspectors recommend the pork ribs with black beans.
items.watchOut: Cash only. Busy with local families at weekends.
items.description: An air-conditioned Southern Thai restaurant on the highway at Lam Kaen, about 4 km from Thap Lamu pier (Similan Islands boats). Good for a group lunch or dinner on the way to Khao Lak.
items.bestTime: Lunch after a Similan trip, or dinner.
tips: Ask what fish came in today.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.3, open, 10:30-22:30, pin on Phet Kasem Road at Lam Kaen). Michelin page read 27 Oct 2026. No review count found.

items.name: Krachang Khao Lak
items.nameThai: กระชังเขาหลัก
items.gmapsQuery: Krachang Khao Lak, 78/155 Mu 5, Lam Kaen, Thai Mueang, Phang Nga
items.priceText: No dish prices found online. Michelin rates it two baht signs; live seafood is sold by weight.
dishes: Shrimp and coconut soup with melinjo (liang) leaves
Live-catch seafood from the daily board
items.praise: In the 2026 Bib Gourmand list. Michelin describes a breezy, rustic place over the water serving mostly live-catch seafood, and calls the grilled giant trevally a rare local fish. Google rating 4.7 (Oct 2026).
items.watchOut: Michelin lists it as open daily, but Google shows it closed on Tuesdays. Call first: +66 95 656 0862.
items.description: A seafood restaurant near Thap Lamu pier, south of Khao Lak; the name means fish cage. The strongest seafood choice on the Phuket to Khao Lak road.
items.bestTime: Late lunch, or an early dinner before dark.
tips: Ask the weight and price of fish before they cook it.
Car park on site; the group fits easily.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.7, closed on the day read, opens Wednesday 12:00). Michelin page read 27 Oct 2026 (Bib Gourmand, hours 12:00-20:00). Named in the Thai government list of 2026 Bib Gourmand winners.

items.name: Krua Luang Ten
items.nameThai: ครัวหลวงเทน
items.gmapsQuery: Krua Luang Ten, 160 Mu 2, Phet Kasem Road, Khuek Khak, Takua Pa
items.priceText: No dish prices found online. Michelin rates it one baht sign (cheap).
dishes: Catch of the day, Southern style
Tai pla (fermented fish curry) dip with free fresh vegetables
items.praise: Michelin (2026 Bib Gourmand): robust Southern Thai flavours, specials built on the daily catch and seasonal produce, tables set on sand floors.
items.watchOut: Short hours: 11:00-13:00 and 17:00-20:00. Closed on the 10th, 20th and 30th of each month. Cash only. Everything is cooked to order, so order all your dishes at the start.
items.description: A local Southern Thai kitchen in north Khao Lak with tables on sand. A good dinner for a night in Khao Lak.
items.openText: Daily 11:00-13:00 and 17:00-20:00; closed on the 10th, 20th and 30th of the month
tips: Order everything at once, as Michelin advises.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.3, hours 11:00-13:00 and 17:00-20:00, pin at Khuek Khak). Michelin page read 27 Oct 2026. No review count found.

items.name: Go Pong
items.gmapsQuery: Go Pong, Khao Lak, Khuek Khak
items.reviewsSource: Google count shown on Wanderlog, read 27 Oct 2026
items.priceText: No current menu prices found; reviewers call it very cheap (Wanderlog review summary, 2024-2026).
dishes: Pork, chicken or beef noodle soup
items.praise: Reviewers repeat that the noodle soups are light and clean and the prices low; a 2024 review praises the beef soup, another the pork noodle soup. Listed by Lonely Planet for Khao Lak.
items.watchOut: Simple open shop on the main road, no air conditioning.
items.description: A noodle shop in Khao Lak centre, opposite Jai Restaurant, that grew from a stall under a plastic awning. The cheap, easy lunch in Khao Lak, with mango sticky rice after.
tips: They can make vegan versions (Wanderlog review).
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.5, open, 12:00-21:00). Wanderlog list shows Google 4.5 (1,454) and Tripadvisor 4.4 (884).

items.name: Bang Niang Market
items.nameThai: ตลาดนัดบางเนียง
items.gmapsQuery: Bang Niang Market, Phet Kasem Road, Khuek Khak, Khao Lak
items.reviewsSource: Google count shown on Wanderlog, read 27 Oct 2026
items.priceText: Fruit shakes about 60 THB, strawberry or mixed shakes about 80 THB, cocktails about 120 THB (Phuket101, Aug 2026). Food stalls are street prices.
dishes: Grilled pork ribs (ask for the soft-bone ones) near the entrance
Moo ping pork skewers with sticky rice
Mango sticky rice, coconut ice cream, banana in coconut milk
items.praise: Phuket101 (updated Aug 2026): the biggest market in Khao Lak, and the food is the main reason to go; the pork ribs stall near the entrance is the one they name first.
items.watchOut: Only four days a week: Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday. Cash only. Clothes and souvenirs are marked up.
items.description: The big open-air evening market in Khao Lak with hundreds of stalls. The easy, cheap dinner for the whole group on a Khao Lak night.
tips: On the other days, The Landmark Night Market nearby opens daily (Phuket101).
Banana Bar next to the market keeps serving after the stalls close.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.2, closed on Tuesday as expected). Phuket101 page updated 17 Aug 2026 (days and hours). Wanderlog shows Google 4.2 (8,990) and Tripadvisor 4.0 (1,481).

items.name: Hok Kee Lao
items.nameThai: ฮกกี่เหลา
items.gmapsQuery: Hok Kee Lao, 207 Rat Bumrung Road, Bang Nai Si, Takua Pa
items.priceText: Crab meat in lime dressing 170 THB, sea cucumber with abalone 350 THB (BK Magazine, Oct 2017, at the old address; expect higher now). Michelin rates it two baht signs.
dishes: Stir-fried soft tofu with minced pork and shrimp
Nam chup yam: Southern chilli relish with fresh vegetables
items.praise: In the Michelin guide since 2020 and a Bib Gourmand in 2026. Michelin calls it a heritage restaurant for Thai, Chinese and Southern flavours that is "well worth making the short trip" from Takua Pa; BK Magazine (2017) said the crab dish is not to be missed. Google rating 4.7 (Oct 2026).
items.watchOut: It moved from the old two-storey house on Sena Rat Road to a bigger place on Rat Bumrung Road: use the new pin. Cash only.
items.description: The best-known Thai-Chinese family restaurant in Takua Pa, now in a larger building that suits a group. Worth the detour if you visit Takua Pa old town from Khao Lak.
tips: Order the tofu with minced pork; Michelin praises its custard-like texture.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.7, 10:30-13:30 and 16:30-21:30, pin at 207 Rat Bumrung Rd). Michelin page read 27 Oct 2026. No review count found.

items.name: Lok-Un
items.nameThai: ร้านหลกอั้น
items.gmapsQuery: Lok-Un, 85 Si Mueang Road, Takua Pa
items.priceText: No dish prices found online. Michelin rates it one baht sign (cheap).
dishes: BBQ red pork (moo daeng) on rice
items.praise: Michelin (2026 selection): a Chinese-Thai shop rooted in Takua Pa's tin-mining community, with a short menu of BBQ pork, crispy pork and braised pork knuckle made the old way, which draws a steady flow of locals. Google 4.6 (Oct 2026).
items.watchOut: Closed on Sunday and closes at 16:00. Cash only.
items.description: An old-school pork-on-rice shop in Takua Pa: red pork, crispy pork and pork knuckle in one plate. A strong pork breakfast or lunch north of Khao Lak.
items.bestTime: Breakfast or lunch; good things sell out by afternoon.
tips: Ask for a mixed plate (khao moo daeng moo krob) with the knuckle on the side.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.6, 07:00-16:00, pin on Si Mueang Road). Michelin page read 27 Oct 2026. No review count found.

items.name: RuenMai
items.nameThai: ร้านอาหารเรือนไม้
items.gmapsQuery: RuenMai Krabi, 117 Moo 3, Sai Thai, Mueang Krabi
items.reviewsSource: Google count shown on Wanderlog, read 27 Oct 2026
items.priceText: Stir-fried prawns with shrimp paste and sator beans 250 THB, fried mackerel with soy sauce 240 THB (BK Magazine, Sep 2019). Most dishes 150-300 THB (Thai Holiday Guide, Jul 2026).
dishes: Goong pad kapi sataw: prawns with shrimp paste and stink beans
Gaeng tai pla: Southern fermented fish curry
items.praise: Listed by BK Magazine in 2017 and its pick for Krabi in 2019; Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026) calls it authentic Southern cooking in a garden; Will Fly For Food (Oct 2026): "the place to visit if it's your first time trying authentic Thai food".
items.watchOut: Outside the walking areas: arrange a car or tuk-tuk both ways. Closed 15:00-17:00. Call ahead at weekends.
items.description: Southern Thai cooking in wooden salas among ponds and gardens, about 10 minutes from Krabi Town on the Ao Nang side. The top all-round dinner choice in Krabi for a group.
items.bestTime: Dinner from 17:00, or a long lunch.
tips: Phone +66 89 288 3232 to book a sala for 8.
They grow many of their own herbs and vegetables.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.7, 10:30-15:00 and 17:00-21:00). Wanderlog shows Google 4.7 (1,730), Tripadvisor 4.5 (109). Thai Holiday Guide updated Jul 2026.

items.name: Nong Joke
items.nameThai: ร้านอาหารน้องโจ๊ก
items.gmapsQuery: Nong Joke, 50/3 Moo 7, Sai Thai Road, Mueang Krabi
items.reviewsSource: Google count shown on Wanderlog, read 27 Oct 2026
items.priceText: Kua kling 120 THB, sour curry with fish and coconut shoots 150 THB (BK Magazine, Sep 2019). Mark Wiens paid 60-150 THB a dish (older post). KTC (Jan 2026) puts a meal at 300-500 THB a person.
dishes: Tom som pla: sour fish soup
Nam prik goong sot: fresh shrimp chilli dip with vegetables
Yellow curry with braised pork leg and young coconut
items.praise: Mark Wiens (Eating Thai Food): "should strive to eat at Nong Joke when in Krabi"; BK Magazine (2019) calls it "fearlessly spicy"; Fah Thai magazine: cherished by local families for Southern Thai food.
items.watchOut: Spicy by default: ask for "mai phet mak" (not very spicy). Closed 14:00-16:00.
items.description: A family Southern Thai restaurant just south of Krabi Town that locals have used for over 40 years. Best for curries, sour soups and seafood.
tips: Try the sour fish soup and the shrimp chilli dip together.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.5, open, 11:00-14:00 and 16:00-21:00). Wanderlog shows Google 4.5 (1,596), Tripadvisor 4.5 (90). KTC list updated 3 Jan 2026.

items.name: Kotung
items.nameThai: ร้านอาหารโกตุง
items.gmapsQuery: Kotung Restaurant, 66 Maharaj Road, Krabi
items.reviewsSource: Google count shown on a Wanderlog place page, read 27 Oct 2026
items.priceText: Crab curry with rice noodles 180 THB, kao yok (braised pork belly with taro) 150 THB, tofu song krueng 120 THB (BK Magazine, Sep 2019). Most dishes 80-150 THB (Thai Holiday Guide, Jul 2026).
dishes: Kao yok: braised pork belly with taro
Crab coconut curry with rice noodles
Tofu with crab meat in Chinese gravy
items.praise: BK Magazine (2019): 36 years of Sino-Thai cooking, so popular it moved to a bigger site; Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026, editor's pick): order the braised pork belly or crab curry. Google reviews in 2026 praise the fresh seafood.
items.watchOut: Closing days vary; check its Facebook page. It is north of the town centre near the bus terminal, not by the river.
items.description: A large Sino-Thai diner in Krabi Town (about 300 seats) known for braised pork belly and crab curry. Easy for 8 people.
tips: Some 2019 diners found the braised pork a little sweet; balance it with gaeng som.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.5, open until 22:00). Wanderlog place page shows Google 4.5 (928) with dated 2026 reviews; Tripadvisor 4.5 (30).

items.name: KoSuang
items.nameThai: ร้านอาหารโกส้วง
items.gmapsQuery: KoSuang Restaurant, 249/7 Utarakit Road, Krabi Town
items.reviewsSource: Google count shown on a Wanderlog place page, read 27 Oct 2026
items.priceText: No current menu prices found; BK Magazine (2019) lists it with Krabi Town's cheap local shops.
dishes: Moo krob: crispy pork belly on rice
Moo daeng: red BBQ pork on rice
Handmade egg noodles with roast duck
items.praise: BK Magazine (2019): expect queues from morning to afternoon, but the pork is "well worth the wait"; a Wongnai reviewer (2021) singled out the red pork. Reviewers on Wanderlog say to order anything with the fresh noodles.
items.watchOut: Morning and lunch only: closes 14:30. There is a smaller second branch (KoSuang 2); this pin is the main shop.
items.description: The best-known pork-on-rice shop in Krabi Town, for crispy pork, red pork and handmade egg noodles. A good breakfast before a boat from Krabi.
tips: Get a mixed plate of crispy and red pork, plus a bowl of egg noodles to share.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.4, 06:30-14:30, opens Wednesday 06:30). Wanderlog place page shows Google 4.4 (1,118), Tripadvisor 4.5 (32). BK Magazine (2019) printed a Vicar Road address, but its phone number (075 612 550) matches this Google listing on Utarakit Road.

items.name: Khanom Jeen Pa Tom
items.nameThai: ร้านขนมจีน ป้าต้อม
items.gmapsQuery: Khanom Jeen Pa Tom, Krabi Road, Krabi Town
items.priceText: Noodles with coconut fish curry (nam ya kati) 20 THB, gaeng tai pla 20 THB, soft-boiled egg 10 THB, fried chicken 15 THB a piece (BK Magazine, Sep 2019; prices have likely risen).
dishes: Khanom jeen (fermented rice noodles) with nam ya kati fish curry
Khanom jeen with gaeng tai pla
items.praise: BK Magazine (2019): well loved for its soft fermented rice noodles and low prices, and says to add the fried chicken. Google 4.5 (Oct 2026).
items.watchOut: Closes at 14:00. Curries are spicy; free fresh vegetables help.
items.description: A local khanom jeen shop in Krabi Town: help-yourself rice noodles with Southern curries and fried chicken, for very little money.
tips: Take a piece of fried chicken with your noodles.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.5, 07:00-14:00). Only one independent source found (BK Magazine 2019), so treat it as a local tip.

items.name: Krabi Town Walking Street
items.nameThai: ถนนคนเดินกระบี่
items.gmapsQuery: Krabi Town Night Market (Walking Street), Maharaj Road, Krabi
items.priceText: Boiled shellfish (hoi chak teen) 50-60 THB a bag, grilled squid skewers 40-60 THB, roti with condensed milk 30 THB, khao man gai 60-70 THB (Thai Holiday Guide, Jul 2026).
dishes: Pad thai in an egg crepe
Coconut ice cream in the shell
items.praise: Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026): the best food variety in Krabi Town; BK Magazine (2019): probably the biggest night bazaar in town, with live music.
items.watchOut: Weekends only (Friday to Sunday). On other nights there are smaller food stalls by Chao Fah pier on the river (about 17:00-22:30, Google Maps).
items.description: The weekend night market in central Krabi Town, with street food, a stage and live music. Cheap and easy for the whole group.
tips: Stalls about 50 m from the stage are said to be 10-20 THB cheaper (Thai Holiday Guide).
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.3, closed on Tuesday as expected). Thai Holiday Guide updated Jul 2026.

items.name: Gecko Cabane
items.gmapsQuery: Gecko Cabane Restaurant, Soi Ruamjit, Krabi Town
items.reviewsSource: Google count shown on Wanderlog, read 27 Oct 2026
items.priceText: No current dish prices found; mid-price for Krabi Town.
items.praise: Will Fly For Food (updated Oct 2026): a cosy place where a French owner and his Thai wife cook Thai food with some Western touches; ranked first on the Wanderlog Krabi Town list.
items.watchOut: Small place; book for 8.
items.description: A small Thai restaurant with a French twist in the old streets of Krabi Town. A relaxed dinner if you stay in town.
tips: Dishes can be made less spicy on request.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.7, open, 12:00-22:00). Wanderlog shows Google 4.7 (1,054), Tripadvisor 4.7 (798).

items.name: Ton Ma Yom Thai Food
items.nameThai: ร้านอาหารต้นมะยม อ่าวนาง
items.gmapsQuery: Ton Ma Yom Thaifood, 262/7 Leela Valley, Ao Nang Soi 11
items.reviewsSource: Google count shown on a Wanderlog place page, read 27 Oct 2026
items.priceText: No menu prices found; 2026 Google reviews call prices "very reasonable".
dishes: Whole steamed fish with soy and ginger
items.praise: Google reviews from Jul-Aug 2026: "Tastes like someone's grandma made it", "Best food in Krabi so far". Will Fly For Food: small, family-run, large portions at fair prices. One Mar 2026 review found the squid chewy.
items.watchOut: Closed on Monday. Queues at peak times; there is no big sign, so use the pin.
items.description: A small family Thai kitchen in a side street of Ao Nang that is full most evenings. The safe local-style dinner in Ao Nang.
tips: Many vegan options (HappyCow).
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.6, 08:00-14:00 and 17:00-21:00). Wanderlog shows Google 4.6 (1,584) and Tripadvisor 4.5 (2,151), with dated 2026 reviews.

items.name: Ra Beung Lay Seafood
items.nameThai: ร้านอาหารระเบียงเลซีฟู้ด
items.gmapsQuery: Ra Beung Lay Seafood Restaurant, 10 Moo 5, Ao Nam Mao, Sai Thai, Krabi
items.reviewsSource: Google count shown on Wanderlog, read 27 Oct 2026
items.priceText: No dish prices found; seafood is priced by weight.
items.praise: Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026): a quieter, slower seafood meal with west-facing sea views and sunsets. High scores on both Google and Tripadvisor.
items.watchOut: A Google 4.8 from 3,400 reviews is very high; the Tripadvisor 4.8 from 490 reviews backs it, but there is little press coverage. Ask seafood prices first.
items.description: A seafood restaurant on Ao Nam Mao bay, next to the pier for longtails to Railay East, with a sunset view. Good after a Railay day.
tips: Book a sea-side table for sunset.
items.verification: Google Maps read 27 Oct 2026 (4.8, open, 11:00-22:00, pin at Ao Nam Mao). Wanderlog shows Google 4.8 (3,410), Tripadvisor 4.8 (490).

items.name: Krua Thara
items.nameThai: ร้านอาหารครัวธารา
items.gmapsQuery: Krua Thara, 82 Moo 5, Nopparat Thara Road, Ao Nang
items.reviewsSource: Google count shown on Wanderlog, read 27 Oct 2026
items.priceText: 300-600 THB a person; fish and crab by weight (Thai Holiday Guide, Jul 2026).
dishes: Pla tod sam rot: fried fish with three-flavour sauce
Mantis shrimp fried with garlic and pepper
items.praise: Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026): its editor's pick for live-tank seafood in Ao Nang. Older Wongnai reviews by Thai diners praise the crab and the mantis shrimp.
items.watchOut: Confirm weight, price per unit and any cooking charge before ordering. Crowded by 19:00 at weekends.
